title: Report a missing item
summary: FastAPI: Report a missing item. Inspect the status as well as the body.
introduction: HTTPException stops normal handling with an error reply. Open GET /missing.
learningObjectives: Report a missing item with FastAPI
Inspect the status as well as the body

blocks.text: Install fastapi and uvicorn with python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn. Save one example as app.py and run uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000. Use the stated route on that address.

blocks.title: Report a missing item
blocks.code:
from fastapi import FastAPI, Query, HTTPException, Response, status
from fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
app = FastAPI()
@app.get("/missing")
def missing():
    raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Book not found")

blocks.text: Raising HTTPException ends the handler. FastAPI sends 404 with the detail field.
Inspect the status as well as the body.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Raise HTTPException; returning it is not the same action.
